history.sg_progress: In MONUSCO, internal consultations between the military and the Mission Support Division are ongoing in order to establish an advisory board on weapons and ammunition. In accordance with the weapons and ammunition policy and the United Nations Manual on Ammunition Management, UNIFIL established a mission-wide advisory board on weapons and ammunition. The advisory board held meetings on 25 November 2020, 6 January 2021 and 12 February 2021. In UNDOF, the advisory board on weapons and ammunition has been established and its first meeting was held on 2 February 2021.
